title: The first 33 apps you should download for your new iPhone (AAPL)
text:
https://www.businessinsider.com/best-ios-apps-and-games-for-iphone-xs-2018-9?utm_source=hearst&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=allverticals The first 33 apps you should download for your new iPhone (AAPL) Kif Leswing, provided by
Published 10:29 am EST, Tuesday, December 25, 2018
You may have received a new iPhone this holiday season. Here are 33 great apps to download for it. Deciding which apps to download from Apple's App Store can be daunting, especially when you have a new phone. After all, there are millions of apps choose from.
We've rounded up 33 of the best apps you should download first on your iPhone. There are some obvious choices on this list, but we've also chosen a few hidden gems that the Tech Insider staff uses and loves.
Let's check them out:
Citizen lets you see if there are emergencies or crimes nearby. iTunes Citizen is a free app .
Moment helps you track screen time. Apple has built-in tools, but a lot of people in the tech world use this app. iTunes Moment is a free app with in-app purchases .
Mindbody lets you book and search workout classes on the go. iTunes Mindbody is a free app . The classes cost money.
